LanguageData.LP_StormLightningBolt.label: lightning bolt
LanguageData.LP_StormLightningBolt.description: Release a straight bolt of lightning in one direction, piercing 15 cells: each person and building along the path takes 12 fire and 20 EMP (stops at walls). Cooldown 6 hours.
LanguageData.LP_SummonStorm.label: summon storm
LanguageData.LP_SummonStorm.description: (Adult) Summon a storm: the map's weather turns to thunderstorm and is locked for 1 day; during that day, every 2 hours a bolt strikes within 3 cells of a random enemy. Cooldown 7 days.
